children: First Breach secured supply agreements and added inspection equipment to support its planned ammunition production ramp.
A supplier agreement gives First Breach the ability to purchase up to 20 million primers per month.
Two additional inspection units are intended to expand throughput and support quality as ammunition volumes grow.
A raw material agreement strengthens access to materials processed in-house and supports more reliable availability.
The developments support plans to scale production toward 20 million rounds per month and transition toward 24-hour operations.
